content: ChatGPT Sites is a thing. Exploring it now. "Here's what I want, wonder if you can do it. I want to write markdown files and publish them somewhere where they can be accessed over the web, not as rendered files, but in markdown source. It should be really simple to use. Couldn't hurt if there was an RSS 2.0 feed, and it would be nice if i could make it something I could share with others so they can write url-accessible markdown files too."
